HighBP.name: HighBP
HighBP.label: High Blood Pressure
HighBP.description: Ever diagnosed with high blood pressure by a doctor or health professional.
HighBP.glossary: Hypertension places chronic strain on arterial walls, accelerating coronary plaque formation.

HighChol.name: HighChol
HighChol.label: High Blood Cholesterol
HighChol.description: Ever told by a doctor or health provider that blood cholesterol is high.
HighChol.glossary: Elevated low-density lipoproteins (LDL) directly contribute to coronary atherogenesis.

CholCheck.name: CholCheck
CholCheck.label: Cholesterol Check in Past 5 Years
CholCheck.description: Had a cholesterol check performed within the past five years.
CholCheck.glossary: Regular cholesterol screening is a marker of preventive cardiovascular maintenance.

BMI.name: BMI
BMI.label: Body Mass Index (BMI)
BMI.description: Body mass index in kg/m², calculated from height and weight.
BMI.glossary: BMI > 25 indicates overweight; > 30 indicates obesity, which strains myocardial workload.

Smoker.name: Smoker
Smoker.label: Smoking History
Smoker.description: Smoked at least 100 cigarettes in entire life.
Smoker.glossary: Tobacco combustion releases toxins that promote endothelial dysfunction and vasospasm.

Stroke.name: Stroke
Stroke.label: History of Stroke
Stroke.description: Ever told by a medical doctor that you had a stroke.
Stroke.glossary: Stroke indicates advanced systemic cerebrovascular atherosclerosis, highly correlated with coronary disease.

Diabetes.name: Diabetes
Diabetes.label: Diabetes Diagnosis
Diabetes.description: Self-reported diagnosis of diabetes or prediabetes.
Diabetes.glossary: Hyperglycemia damages micro- and macro-vasculature, doubling coronary heart disease risk.

PhysActivity.name: PhysActivity
PhysActivity.label: Physical Activity (Past 30 Days)
PhysActivity.description: Any physical activity or exercise during the past 30 days other than regular job.
PhysActivity.glossary: Cardiorespiratory exercise enhances myocardial perfusion and improves vascular compliance.

Fruits.name: Fruits
Fruits.label: Daily Fruit Consumption
Fruits.description: Consumes fruit 1 or more times per day.
Fruits.glossary: Dietary antioxidants and polyphenols support healthy vascular endothelium.

Veggies.name: Veggies
Veggies.label: Daily Vegetable Consumption
Veggies.description: Consumes vegetables 1 or more times per day.
Veggies.glossary: Dietary fiber and nitrates in vegetables contribute to arterial blood pressure reduction.

HvyAlcoholConsump.name: HvyAlcoholConsump
HvyAlcoholConsump.label: Heavy Alcohol Consumption
HvyAlcoholConsump.description: Adult men >14 drinks/week; adult women >7 drinks/week.
HvyAlcoholConsump.glossary: Chronic heavy ethanol consumption induces toxic alcoholic cardiomyopathy and hypertension.

AnyHealthcare.name: AnyHealthcare
AnyHealthcare.label: Health Care Coverage
AnyHealthcare.description: Has any kind of health care coverage (insurance, prepaid plans, Medicare).
AnyHealthcare.glossary: Insurance coverage dictates access to routine preventive cardiological management.

NoDocbcCost.name: NoDocbcCost
NoDocbcCost.label: Could Not Afford Doctor
NoDocbcCost.description: Was there a time in the past 12 months when you needed to see a doctor but could not because of cost?
NoDocbcCost.glossary: Cost barriers frequently cause unmonitored hypertension and missed therapeutic interventions.

GenHlth.name: GenHlth
GenHlth.label: General Health Rating
GenHlth.description: Would you say that in general your health is: 1=Excellent, 2=Very good, 3=Good, 4=Fair, 5=Poor.
GenHlth.glossary: Self-rated general health is one of the strongest epidemiological predictors of mortality.

MentHlth.name: MentHlth
MentHlth.label: Poor Mental Health Days
MentHlth.description: Now thinking about your mental health, how many days during the past 30 days was your mental health not good?
MentHlth.glossary: Chronic emotional stress elevates autonomic sympathetic tone and circulating cortisol.

PhysHlth.name: PhysHlth
PhysHlth.label: Poor Physical Health Days
PhysHlth.description: Now thinking about your physical health, how many days during the past 30 days was your physical health not good?
PhysHlth.glossary: Frequent poor physical health reflects underlying multisystem morbidity and functional decline.

DiffWalk.name: DiffWalk
DiffWalk.label: Difficulty Walking / Climbing Stairs
DiffWalk.description: Do you have serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs?
DiffWalk.glossary: Severe mobility impairment correlates with advanced cardiovascular deconditioning and frailty.

Sex.name: Sex
Sex.label: Biological Sex
Sex.glossary: Males exhibit earlier onset of coronary artery disease, whereas females catch up post-menopause.

Age.name: Age
Age.label: Age Category
Age.glossary: Chronological age is the non-modifiable driver of cumulative vascular exposure and arterial stiffness.

Education.name: Education
Education.label: Highest Education Level
Education.description: Education level completed (1 = Never/Kindergarten ... 6 = College 4+ years).
Education.glossary: Educational attainment is a fundamental social determinant of health literacy and lifestyle options.

Income.name: Income
Income.label: Household Income Bracket
Income.description: Annual household income bracket from all sources.
Income.glossary: Socioeconomic standing determines nutrition quality, neighborhood safety, and chronic stress exposure.
